decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster builds directly on the firm's core pumping and coolant-management knowledge, so it can read market feedback well and improve the product with its own engineering.

Centrifugal coolant cleaning fits the firm's filtration expertise and its sustainability goals, and the firm is well placed to assimilate early results and keep developing the product, even though it is somewhat more specialised.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a mainstay of the firm's conveying business for metalworking customers, so the product rests on deep existing knowledge and steady demand.
Hinged belt chip conveyors draw on the same core conveying competence and serve established machine tool customers, so the firm should keep the product and refine it.
